name: Ta'abbata Sharran
bio: Thabit ibn Jabir of Fahm, known as Ta'abbata Sharran, was a pre-Islamic poet from Tihama. The stories about his raids dwell on his speed on foot, while his own verse gives a precise account of the kind of companion on whom a traveller could rely. Al-Mufaddal al-Dabbi placed his “Ya idu” first in his anthology. Al-Zirikli says that he was killed in Hudhayl territory and that his body was found in the cave of Rakhman, dating his death to around eighty years before the Hijra (about 540 CE).
